text: The man who discovered gravity lost up to 20,000 pounds in a bubble.
In 1720, all of London wanted shares in the South Sea Company.
In six months, the price jumped from about 130 pounds to over 1,000 pounds.
Even I don't rise that fast.
So what did the smartest man in England do?
He sold most of his shares early, a smart, tidy profit.
it. Then, prices kept climbing. Everyone around him kept getting richer. And that's where
Genius stopped helping. He bought back in, at roughly double the price. Then, the bubble
burst. Isaac Newton lost a fortune. Historians still debate exactly how much. That's the
mirage. Being smart doesn't protect you from the crowd. He supposedly said he could
calculate the stars, but not the madness of people. Gravity always wins! Comment,
